question: Who was the president of the second session of the Indian National Congress?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dadabhai Naoroji.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dadabhai Naoroji:-**

 
 
• He was a prominent Indian **nationalist leader,** a member of the** Indian National Congress**, and the **first Indian **to be elected to the **British Parliament.**
 
• **The president of the second session of the Indian National Congress was Dadabhai Naoroji.**
 
• Naoroji was a prominent economist and is known for his theories on the economic exploitation of India by the British colonial administration.
 
• He highlighted the concept of the "Drain of Wealth," which referred to the economic resources being drained from India to Britain due to colonial policies.
 
• One of Naoroji's most famous works is the book titled "Poverty and Un-British Rule in India," published in 1901. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Womesh Chandra Bonnerjee:-**

 
 
• He was the **first president** of the Indian National Congress and served in that position twice, in **1885 and 1892.**
 
 
 
• **Pherozeshah Mehta:-**
 
 
• He​ was a** lawyer, social reformer, and political leader** who played a prominent role in the Indian National Congress and the Indian independence movement.
 
 
 
• **George Yule:-**
 
 
• **​**He was a **British businessman **who served as the president of the Indian National Congress in 1888**.**
